title: Local C^{j,alpha} on a ball gives global C^{j,alpha} (IsHolderCkα) on the half ball
statement: For m, k, j in N, alpha in R, u : R^m -> R^k, x0 in R^m and r in R: if IsLocallyHolderCkα j alpha u (ball x0 r) then IsHolderCkα j alpha u (ball x0 (r/2)), i.e. u is C^j on the half ball, all derivatives of order <= j are bounded there by one constant, and D^j u is alpha-Hoelder there with one constant.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (u : Rn m → Rn k) (x₀ : Rn m) (r : ℝ), IsLocallyHolderCkα j α u (ball x₀ r) → IsHolderCkα j α u (ball x₀ (r / 2))
